title: Bose acquires Skullcandy
description: Bose Corporation is acquiring lifestyle audio brand Skullcandy. A joint press release reveals that the two companies will combine Bose’s audio expertise with Skullcandy’s design and community connections for their future products. As such, Skullcandy will remain a separate brand within Bose’s Premium Consumer Audio lineup and will continue to be based in Park City, Utah. As a privately held company, we have the freedom to make bold, long-term investments in opportunities we believe in, and Skullcandy is a great example of that. They have an established, thriving brand, and together we...

title: New evidence points to the vivo X500 E being a rebranded vivo V80
description: Earlier this year, vivo launched the X300 E, which was an upgraded version of the V70 – it had a similar 6.59” display, the same 50+50+8MP camera setup and a nearly identical design. However, the X-series phone had a premium chipset (Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 vs. Snapdragon 7 Gen 4) and a bigger battery (7,200mAh vs. 6,500mAh). Now we’ve been seeing rumors about a vivo X500 E. Will that be an upgraded version of the vivo V80? That is starting to look unlikely. First, the Google Play Console slashed our expectations of the chipset, revealing that it is the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 – the same chip that...

title: These are the Oppo Reno17 models launching in India according to a new rumor
description: Earlier today, the Oppo Reno17 Pro had its specs leak, and we also recently heard that it may skip India. Now a tipster on X has backed that up, and also revealed which devices in the family will actually make it to India: the Reno17 and the Reno17c. The Reno17 will allegedly be powered by the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 SoC, while the Reno17c will use the Dimensity 7300. Those are the same chipsets found in the Reno16 and Reno16c, respectively, and the same tipster previously said that the Reno17 series will have "almost the same specs" as its predecessors. title: Here's when the OnePlus Ace 7 series is launching
description: OnePlus has finally set a launch date for its upcoming Ace 7 series in China. The lineup is confirmed to include the Ace 7 and the Ace 7 Pro. The company has also revealed the key specs of the Pro variant. The OnePlus Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro will debut in China on October 29. Both devices are already available for pre-order via the official Oppo online store in the country. Alongside setting a launch date, OnePlus also revealed that the Ace 7 will be equipped with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V series chipset, whereas the Ace 7 Pro will use the standard 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC. Both...

title: Sony Xperia 1 VII gets Android 17 update
description: Following the Xperia 1 VIII (MK8)’s Android 17 update, Sony has now begun seeding the latest version of Google’s mobile OS to the Xperia 1 VII (MK7). Several Xperia 1 VII users on Reddit have reported that the Android 17 update is now arriving on their devices with the version 71.2.A.2.35 identifier. Sony Xperia 1 VII Android 17 update screen (source: Reddit) The update is reportedly seeding to users across Europe and will likely reach more regions in the coming days. It comes in at 1.1GB and brings the same core features as the one for the MK8. These include the redesigned quick...

title: Oppo Enco X4 unboxing and hands-on
description: These are Oppo's Enco X4 earbuds, its flagship noise-cancelling product, which just made its international debut. The buds are launching alongside the Oppo Find X10 series. In the box, you get the Enco X4 in its case along with S, M, and L silicone eartips. Like previous Enco products, the X4 comes with Dynaudio-tuned sound, and the audio brand's logo comes on the case itself. Oppo found a way to make the plastic case interesting by adding a subtle silver line accenting the top and bottom. The case is clad in a smooth, almost pearlescent plastic. The Enco X4's case The...

title: iQOO 16R receives its first certification ahead of release
description: Last week we told you that the iQOO Z12 Turbo's chipset leaked along with its screen size, and that it will very likely be sold outside of China as the iQOO 16R, just like the Z11 Turbo became the iQOO 15R. Today, the iQOO 16R has received its first certification, showing up in Indonesia's TKDN database with the model number I2606. The listing confirms the iQOO branding and 5G support. The same model number was spotted in the GSM Association’s IMEI database back in early September, which is where the iQOO 16R name first surfaced. Going by the Z12 Turbo leaks, the 16R should come...

title: Another nubia A76 4G debuts quietly with a larger display, faster charging battery
description: The nubia A75 came out in early 2024 – it was an affordable 4G phone. Since then, the company has introduced the nubia A76 4G and the nubia A77 4G. Now it’s time to say hello to the nubia A76! Wait, what? Okay, this is another case of overlapping names because this A76 and the old A76 are not the same. The new ZTE nubia A76 4G features a 6.75” display – it only has 720p+ resolution and runs at only 90Hz, but it’s better than what the other A76 has (6.5” 720p+ 60Hz). This display promises a modest 500 nits of brightness. nubia mentions the “flagship-inspired design” for the new...

title: OnePlus Turbo Pro to borrow a lot from the OnePlus 16, key specs leak
description: OnePlus launched the Turbo 6 in China back in January, and that phone later served as the basis for the Nord 6, which launched in April. Now, Digital Chat Station on Weibo says a Turbo Pro is on the way too, and it should arrive around the end of the year. The tipster's post has since been edited to just say "good morning", which tends to happen when a brand isn't happy with what he reveals. The Turbo Pro will allegedly come with a 6.78-inch flat 1.5K screen with a 185Hz refresh rate, the 3nm Qualcomm SM8845 Pro chipset, a 200MP main camera with a large sensor, and a battery of at least...

title: Apple warns of limited iPhone Duo stock for walk-in buyers on launch day
description: The iPhone Duo goes on sale this Friday, October 23, but if you were hoping to just walk into an Apple Store and pick one up, you may want to rethink that plan. In a statement, Apple says there will be "limited" availability for walk-in customers, and given the "extraordinary" demand since pre-orders began last week, it expects that supply to sell out quickly. [#InlinePriceWidget,13804,1#] Limited walk-in stock will be available in the US, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the Netherlands, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Türkiye, and the UK. Certain Apple...

title: Spotify launches podcast Memberships, creators keep 90% of the revenue
description: Spotify first previewed Memberships at its Investor Day back in May, and today the feature is rolling out in 34 markets. It lets eligible podcast creators charge their biggest fans a monthly fee for exclusive content and perks, and it replaces the podcast subscriptions Spotify introduced in 2021. Creators get to decide what their Membership includes: exclusive audio or video, bonus episodes, fewer ads, early access, access to a show's archive, or all of the above. They can also split their benefits into up to three tiers, each with its own price. Spotify isn't setting prices itself, though...

title: Oppo sets its sights on Europe with faster launches and carrier partnerships
description: Until recently, smartphone makers focused on developing markets to grow their market share as the markets for premium phones were close to saturated. However, the massive increases in memory prices have caused makers to do a 180° turn and focus their attention on the premium market. Memory prices are so high that RAM and storage dominate the bill of materials on entry-level phones, making them unsustainable at their old prices. Meanwhile, premium devices have the margins to better absorb the price increases and they are aimed at a less price-sensitive audience. Oppo has set its...

title: Samsung and SK Hynix are upgrading their NAND factories in China
description: Chinese memory maker YMTC became China’s biggest producer of NAND flash chips this year with a market share of 38.5%, up from 28% last year. This allowed it to overtake Samsung, which is #2 with 33.5% share (down from 36%) and SK Hynix, which is #3 with 17% (down from 20%). So, now the two Korean companies are working on upgrading their production capacity in China. Samsung’s facility in Xian, China, accounts for around 40% of its global NAND production capacity. However, it only makes relatively old chips with around 200 layers (more layers = more storage per chip). There is an ongoing...

title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max Hasselblad teleconverter kit samples
description: It has become the norm for high-end cameraphones to offer support for a telephoto accessory lens and the Find X10 Pro Max can be outfitted with the Hasselblad Teleconverter Kit. We already did the unboxing a couple of weeks ago, but we now have some samples to show you. But still, let's go over the hardware in a bit more detail first. The concept and most of the practical implementation of the teleconverter is the same as on the Find X9 Pro. You have a lens extender for the telephoto camera, which bayonets to a metal plate, itself sliding to mount to a dedicated case. The plate...

title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max review
Oppo Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max go global
description: Oppo is launching its Find X10 series internationally today. The exact timing will vary from country to country, but Oppo.com has kicked off sales in several regions already. First, we should note that there is a regional difference in the battery capacity. The Oppo Find X10 Pro Max launched with an 8,000mAh battery in China, but European models will ship with 7,150mAh batteries. The same goes for the vanilla X10 – 7,150mAh battery in Europe, down from 8,000mAh in China. Note: the Oppo Find X10 and X10 Pro Max for Europe have 7,150mAh batteries, not 8,000mAh We haven’t gotten a...

title: Honor Win RT2 and Win Turbo2 go official with 12,070mAh batteries
description: Honor has unveiled its Win2 series in China, consisting of the Win2, Win RT2, and Win Turbo2. In this post, we’ll focus on the Win RT2 and Win Turbo2, both of which pack massive 12,070mAh batteries. The Honor Win RT2 is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, paired with LPDDR5X Ultra RAM and UFS 4.1 storage. It also gets in-house display and communication chipsets. The Win RT2 also comes with an in-built active cooling fan that sits within the rear camera island. According to Honor, the fan can reduce temperatures by up to 6 degrees Celsius under load. Meanwhile, the...

title: Honor Win2 and Win Tablet launch with built-in fans and big batteries
description: Honor launched the Win in China back in December, and today its successor is official after weeks of teasers and leaks. The Honor Win2 arrives alongside the Win RT2 and Win Turbo2, as well as the company's first Win-branded tablet. The Win2 comes with a 6.89-inch 1440x3104 OLED screen with a 185Hz refresh rate and 10,000-nit peak brightness, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, up to 16GB of RAM and 1TB of storage, a 200MP 1/1.4-inch main camera with OIS, a 12MP ultrawide, a 50MP selfie camera, a 10,100 mAh battery with 100W wired and 80W wireless charging, IP68/IP69/IP69K ratings...

title: vivo Buds Ultra launch in Europe with 60dB ANC and dual drivers
description: Back in June, vivo unveiled the TWS 5 Pro buds in China alongside the X Fold6. Now, what looks like the very same pair of earbuds is making its way to Europe under a new name - vivo Buds Ultra. They use a hybrid driver setup, with an ultra-compact balanced armature co-developed with Knowles sitting in the center of the diaphragm of a dual-fold dynamic driver developed by vivo. The company says this coaxial design aligns the acoustic centers of the bass and treble for a balanced sound, while a dedicated acoustic tube physically isolates high and low frequencies. There's a 16Hz-60kHz...

title: vivo X500 Ultra said to use a larger telephoto sensor over its predecessor
description: Back in July, well-known tipster Digital Chat Station claimed that vivo was deciding between three 200MP sensors for the telephoto camera on its upcoming camera flagship, the X500 Ultra. Now, the tipster suggests that the company may have made its choice. According to a recent post by the tipster, the latest engineering sample of the vivo X500 Ultra is testing a 200MP 1/1.2-inch sensor for the telephoto camera. vivo appears to have found a way to accommodate the larger sensor without taking up too much internal space.
